data.spec: Source docs/architecture.md, apps/server/src/app.ts, packages/contracts/src/index.ts. GET /api/health; GET /api/stations → Station[]; GET /api/requests → OfficeRequest[]; POST /api/requests/:id/transcript {text:trimmed nonempty string <=2000} → EventResponse; POST /api/requests/:id/approve {proposal_fingerprint:string} → OfficeRequest; POST /api/requests/:id/resolve {} → OfficeRequest. GET /api/events is SSE with named requests.updated events {request_id:string}; clients refresh durable state on updates/reconnect and retain polling recovery. Errors carry error:string plus non-success status. user_id stays nullable. Statuses: awaiting_input,processing,awaiting_approval,needs_clarification,maintenance_open,ordered,resolved,failed.
